fusions.name: Scale Flick
fusions.desc: Flicks a scale that deals 4 damage. Its damage rises 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Startled Scatter
fusions.desc: Bursts out in a cone 5 tiles long, dealing 12 damage to everything in it and knocking it back 2.5 tiles. For 4 seconds afterwards you move 20% faster.

fusions.name: Slip the Net
fusions.desc: Slips you instantly to a point up to 7 tiles away and gives you 20% dodge chance. Your movement speed rises 25% for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Silver Minnow
fusions.desc: Calls a bonded minnow that fights beside you, striking for 3 damage every 1.4 seconds within 5 tiles.
